description: Append-only ledger of semantic capability transitions. Body-changing migrations must cross-link to Prompt Quality History source migrations via source_migration_refs and agree on hashes/IDs (PSC015). Candidate inference cannot append here directly.
cross_link_rule: Every body-changing capability migration (where old_canonical_sha256 != new_canonical_sha256) must reference a matching Prompt Quality History semantic migration via source_migration_ref and the two ledgers must agree on prompt_id, old/new source hashes, and affected IDs. NO_CAPABILITY_CHANGE must still reference the source migration and prove via focused tests that no protected capability weakened. PSC015 enforces this.
proof_ceiling: Shape only. No semantic lifecycle enforcement is proven until Sprint 1B implements the validator and fixtures. This file reserves the ledger shape for Sprint 0.
